title: Planetshift fork configuration
description: Read by the pipeline and, when the site is built, by the app. Each switch under `departures` is a place where Planetshift departs from FaIR's own physics: `default` is the website's value and `plainFair` the value that keeps to FaIR. A switch left out takes its default. Visitors never see these switches.

noxMethane.description: The methane a kg less NOx leaves in the air. hoor: FaIR's global coefficient shared between land and sea by Hoor et al. (2009)'s ratio, its world total kept. fair: FaIR's one coefficient for every source. chemistry: land NOx's methane set to the chemistry models' (Hoor et al. 2009, about 0.3 kg of methane per kg of NO₂ from road traffic) and ships' to theirs, each following FaIR's change with the scenario.

aviationNonCo2.description: What less flying cuts besides CO₂. lee2021: Lee et al. (2021)'s non-CO₂ forcing (contrails, NOx, soot, sulphate, water vapour) per kg of aviation CO₂. fair: aviation's own NOx, SO₂, black and organic carbon as co-emissions through FaIR's coefficients, and no contrails, which FaIR does not have.

permafrost.description: on: the Permafrost option is offered to visitors (off for them by default). off: the permafrost module is left out of the build, with its option.

shippingSulphur2020.description: on: the IMO's 2020 limit on ships' fuel sulphur adds its published forcing (0.12 W/m², 0.08–0.14) outside FaIR's calibrated ensemble, in the baseline and the scenario alike, as FaIR's response to the world's SO₂ barely sees it. off: plain FaIR, with the scenario's own shipping SO₂ only.
